record.question: Under Section 230 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, giving or fabricating false evidence relates to:
options: The commission of any offence punishable with imprisonment for a term of less than seven years.
The commission of any non-cognizable offence only.
The commission of a capital offence punishable with death.
The commission of any offence punishable with imprisonment for life or imprisonment for a term of seven years or more.
